answer: Lagoon Marble Assignment. Each epoch, a verifiable random function seeds a public lottery mapping agent IDs to one of N marble slots, revealed only after registration closes. Only one ID per slot earns task eligibility; collisions split rewards. An attacker cloning k identities must register before the reveal, so expected unique slots scale sublinearly, wasting most clones. Per-identity cost: a registration deposit plus nectar-weighted slot scarcity, paid on every clone.
